name: Shower Installation

faqs.question: What's included in shower installation?
faqs.answer: We install shower valves, trim kits, showerheads, handheld sprayers, and connect all plumbing lines, ensuring proper water pressure and temperature control.

faqs.question: Can you install custom shower systems?
faqs.answer: Yes, we install custom shower systems including rain heads, body sprays, digital controls, and multi-function shower panels.

faqs.question: How long does shower installation take?
faqs.answer: Basic shower fixture installation takes 2-4 hours, while complete shower system installations may take a full day depending on complexity.

faqs.question: Do you install shower pans and surrounds?
faqs.answer: We handle the plumbing connections. For tile and surround work, we can coordinate with qualified contractors or recommend trusted partners.

faqs.question: Can you convert a tub to a shower?
faqs.answer: Yes, we handle all plumbing aspects of tub-to-shower conversions including drain relocation, valve installation, and fixture mounting.

faqs.question: What shower brands do you install?
faqs.answer: We install all major brands including Kohler, Delta, Moen, American Standard, Grohe, and custom luxury shower systems.

description: Complete shower installation services including fixtures, valves, and plumbing connections
